blocks.tamil_translation: whoever was fasting was unable to do any work. Those who were not fasting took the trouble to water the riding animals and graze the riding animals, and did many other services as well. Seeing this, Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Today those who are not fasting have carried off all the reward.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ نِ الْخُدْرِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: كُنَّا نَغْزُو مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ فِي رَمَضَانَ، فَمِنَّا الصَّائِمُ وَمِنَّا الْمُفْطِرُ، فَلَا يَجِدُ الصَّائِمُ عَلَي الْمُفْطِرِ، وَلَا الْمُفْطِرُ عَلَي الصَّائِمِ، يَرَوْنَ أَنَّ مَنْ وَجَدَ قُوَّةً فَصَامَ،فَإِنَّ ذلِكَ حَسَنٌ، وَيَرَوْنَ أَنَّ مَنْ وَجَدَ ضَعْفاً فَأَفْطَرَ، فَإِنَّ ذلِكَ حَسَنٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب جوازالصوم والفطر في شهر رمضان....، رقم: ٢٦١٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) narrates: “We used to go out on military expeditions with the Prophet ﷺ in the month of Ramadan. At such times some of us would fast and some would not fast. The one fasting would not feel displeased with the one not fasting, and likewise the one not fasting would not feel displeased with the one fasting. Whoever felt that he had strength would fast; what he did was right for him. Whoever felt weakness within himself would not fast; what he did was also right!” All of us used to hold this view.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ الْخَطْمِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَسْتَوْدِعَ الْجَيْشَ قَالَ: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللهَ دِينَكُمْ وَأَمَانَتَكُمْ وَخَوَاتِيمَ أَعْمَالِكُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في الدعاء عند الوداع، رقم:٢٦٠١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah Khatmi (RA) says: whenever the Prophet ﷺ intended to send off an army, he would say, “(أَسْتَوْدِعُ )اللهَ دِينَكُمْ وَأَمَانَتَكُمْ وَخَوَاتِيمَ أَعْمَالِكُمْI entrust your Deen,
